opinions.text:
Application to vacate stay of execution of sentence of death entered by the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit on November 8, 2012, presented to Justice Sotomayor, and by her referred to the Court, denied.
Justice Alito took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
